S. a. l.; ed. שונרא שירה נאה … שינרא שינוי רע) if one sees a cat in his dream. in a place where they call it shunnara, it means that a bad change is prepared for him; where it is called shurana, it means that a sweet song (joy) &c.—Pl. שׁוּנָּרִין, שׁוּנָּרַיָּיא.
